title: Software supply chain
description: Build provenance, artifact verification and software inventory checks for teams that publish packages or deploy images.

sources.title: ASD 2026 Minimum Elements for a Software Bill of Materials

rules.instruction: Have the approved build platform record the source revision, build identity and output digests for release artifacts. Attach the provenance to the release evidence.
rules.verification: For a test release, compare the attestation subject digest with the generated artifact and confirm that the source revision matches the release commit.

rules.instruction: For releases gated by provenance, verify the artifact digest, attestation authenticity, builder identity and source before promotion. Record the required SLSA Build level if the organization has adopted one.
rules.verification: Run the approved verifier on a test artifact and record its verdict. Use a fixture with a mismatched digest to confirm the gate stops promotion.

rules.instruction: Generate a software bill of materials (SBOM) for each release artifact in an SPDX or CycloneDX format and version accepted by its consumers. Include shipped direct and transitive components and record any gaps.
rules.verification: Validate the SBOM against the selected format version, review component coverage against the resolved dependencies and built artifact, and link the inventory to the release digest.

rules.instruction: Set the audience for provenance and SBOM records. Review the metadata before sharing it outside the project.
rules.verification: Confirm that the records reach the approved audience, contain no credentials and disclose only the internal identifiers authorized for that audience.
